items.title: Longitudinal Course of Muscle Status in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.abstract: Muscle impairment is a common complication of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but longitudinal data regarding its clinical course remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of muscle impairment and longitudinal changes in muscle status in patients with RA and to identify factors associated with muscle impairment. This retrospective cohort study included 75 patients with RA who underwent assessment of skeletal muscle mass index (SMI) using bioelectrical impedance analysis and handgrip strength at baseline and follow-up. Muscle status was classified according to the Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia 2025 criteria using handgrip strength and height-adjusted SMI as normal muscle status, low muscle mass, possible sarcopenia, or sarcopenia. Patients with low muscle mass, possible sarcopenia, or sarcopenia were categorized as having muscle impairment. Baseline characteristics associated with muscle impairment were evaluated using logistic regression analysis. Longitudinal changes in SMI, handgrip strength, and muscle status were assessed over a median follow-up of 29 months. At baseline, 20 patients (26.7%) had normal muscle status, whereas 55 (73.3%) had muscle impairment, including 30 (40.0%) with sarcopenia. Patients with muscle impairment were older and had lower body mass index (BMI), more advanced Steinbrocker stage, worse physical function, and lower health-related quality of life than those with normal muscle status. In multivariable logistic regression analysis, older age (odds ratio [OR] 1.10, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.03-1.20, p = 0.009) and lower BMI (OR 0.79, 95% CI 0.65-0.92, p = 0.005) were independently associated with muscle impairment. No significant changes in SMI or handgrip strength were observed during follow-up. Among patients with normal muscle status at baseline, 78% remained normal at follow-up, whereas 86% of those with muscle impairment continued to exhibit impaired muscle status. Muscle impairment was highly prevalent in patients with RA and was independently associated with older age and lower BMI. No significant longitudinal changes in muscle status were detected during follow-up, with most patients retaining their baseline muscle status classification. These findings provide longitudinal evidence that muscle impairment tends to persist in patients with established RA.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎患者肌肉状态的纵向变化过程
items.abstractZh: 肌肉损伤是类风湿关节炎（RA）的常见并发症，但关于其临床过程的纵向数据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估RA患者肌肉损伤的患病率及肌肉状态的纵向变化，并确定与肌肉损伤相关的因素。这项回顾性队列研究纳入了75例RA患者，他们在基线和随访时接受了生物电阻抗分析评估骨骼肌质量指数（SMI）和握力测量。根据亚洲肌少症工作组2025年标准，使用握力和身高调整后的SMI将肌肉状态分类为正常肌肉状态、低肌肉质量、可能肌少症或肌少症。低肌肉质量、可能肌少症或肌少症的患者被归类为具有肌肉损伤。使用逻辑回归分析评估与肌肉损伤相关的基线特征。在中位随访29个月期间评估了SMI、握力和肌肉状态的纵向变化。基线时，20例患者（26.7%）肌肉状态正常，而55例（73.3%）存在肌肉损伤，其中30例（40.0%）患有肌少症。与肌肉状态正常的患者相比，肌肉损伤患者年龄更大，体重指数（BMI）更低，Steinbrocker分期更晚期，身体功能更差，健康相关生活质量更低。在多变量逻辑回归分析中，年龄较大（比值比[OR] 1.10，95%置信区间[CI] 1.03-1.20，p = 0.009）和BMI较低（OR 0.79，95% CI 0.65-0.92，p = 0.005）与肌肉损伤独立相关。随访期间未观察到SMI或握力的显著变化。基线时肌肉状态正常的患者中，78%在随访时保持正常，而肌肉损伤患者中86%继续表现出肌肉状态受损。肌肉损伤在RA患者中非常普遍，并与年龄较大和BMI较低独立相关。随访期间未检测到肌肉状态的显著纵向变化，大多数患者保持其基线肌肉状态分类。这些发现提供了纵向证据，表明肌肉损伤在已确诊的RA患者中倾向于持续存在。

items.title: Therapeutic management of axial spondyloarthritis: summary of 2024 update of the Spanish clinical practice guideline (ESPOGUIA).
items.abstract: Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) is a chronic inflammatory rheumatic disease associated with significant morbidity and impaired quality of life. Rapid advances in diagnosis, monitoring, and especially treatment over the past decade have increased the complexity of axSpA management and contributed to variability in clinical practice. To address this need, the Spanish Society of Rheumatology (SER) has developed an updated version of ESPOGUÍA, its clinical practice guideline for spondyloarthritis. This review summarizes the updated recommendations. A multidisciplinary panel (including rheumatologists, other medical specialists, nurses, physiotherapists, methodologists, and patients) formulated key clinical questions using the PICO framework. Systematic literature reviews covering the period 2018-2023 were conducted across major databases. Evidence quality and strength of recommendations were assessed using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) methodology. When evidence was insufficient, recommendations were formulated through a structured deliberative consensus process using the GRADE Evidence-to-Decision framework. Patient representatives actively contributed throughout the process, and the draft guideline underwent public consultation. ESPOGUÍA provides evidence-based recommendations for the management of adult patients with axSpA, focusing on pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. The guideline addresses the use of biologic and targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, prognostic factors for treatment response and radiographic progression, management of treatment failure, and strategies for treatment optimization, including dose tapering. Special attention is given to extra-musculoskeletal manifestations such as uveitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and psoriasis. Non-pharmacological approaches-including physical activity, smoking cessation, weight management, and nurse-led education-are emphasized as integral components of comprehensive care. ESPOGUÍA 2024 offers a comprehensive, evidence-based framework to support harmonized and patient-centered management of axSpA in Spain. By integrating recent therapeutic advances and multidisciplinary perspectives, the guideline aims to reduce variability in clinical practice, improve outcomes, and enhance quality of life for patients with axSpA, while also identifying key areas for future research.

items.titleZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎的治疗管理：2024年西班牙临床实践指南（ESPOGUIA）更新摘要
items.abstractZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）是一种慢性炎症性风湿病，与显著的发病率和生活质量受损相关。过去十年中，诊断、监测尤其是治疗方面的快速进展增加了axSpA管理的复杂性，并导致了临床实践的差异性。为满足这一需求，西班牙风湿病学会（SER）制定了其脊柱关节炎临床实践指南ESPOGUÍA的更新版本。本综述总结了更新后的建议。一个多学科专家组（包括风湿病学家、其他医学专家、护士、物理治疗师、方法学家和患者）使用PICO框架制定了关键临床问题。在主要数据库中进行了涵盖2018-2023年期间的系统文献综述。使用推荐分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法评估证据质量和推荐强度。当证据不足时，通过使用GRADE证据到决策框架的结构化审议共识过程制定建议。患者代表在整个过程中积极贡献，指南草案经过了公开咨询。ESPOGUÍA为成人axSpA患者的管理提供了基于证据的建议，重点关注药物和非药物干预。该指南涉及生物制剂和靶向合成改善病情抗风湿药的使用、治疗反应和影像学进展的预后因素、治疗失败的管理以及治疗优化策略（包括剂量递减）。特别关注关节外表现，如葡萄膜炎、炎症性肠病和银屑病。非药物方法——包括体育活动、戒烟、体重管理和护士主导的教育——被强调为综合护理的组成部分。ESPOGUÍA 2024提供了一个全面的、基于证据的框架，以支持西班牙axSpA的协调和以患者为中心的管理。通过整合近期治疗进展和多学科视角，该指南旨在减少临床实践中的差异性，改善结局，并提高axSpA患者的生活质量，同时确定未来研究的关键领域。

items.title: Recurrent uveitis unveiling axial spondyloarthritis: is inflammatory back pain always the main road to diagnosis? A monocentric cohort.
items.abstract: Nongranulomatous acute anterior uveitis (NG-AAU) is the most common extra-articular manifestation of spondyloarthritis (SpA) and may be a warning sign of previously undiagnosed axial SpA (ax-SpA). Given the known diagnostic delay of ax-SpA, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of previously undiagnosed ax-SpA among NG-AAU patients and to characterize the clinical features of ax-SpA identified through uveitis. Cross-sectional study. This monocentric study included consecutive NG-AAU patients referred to a tertiary ophthalmologic center between August 2024 and August 2025. All patients underwent a comprehensive rheumatologic assessment, including human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27) testing and sacro-iliac joint magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Ultrasound evaluation of entheses and symptomatic joints was also performed. SpA diagnosis was established by expert opinion based on clinical, laboratory, and imaging findings. Among 68 NG-AAU patients, 38 without a previous rheumatic diagnosis were included. Sixteen (43.2%) received a new diagnosis of ax-SpA, and none with peripheral SpA. HLA-B27 positivity was more frequent in ax-SpA than in non-SpA patients (56% vs 33%). All ax-SpA patients reported prior episodes of back pain, although inflammatory back pain was present in only 56.3% at the time of evaluation. Mean Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI) scores and symptom duration were significantly higher in ax-SpA patients ( p  = 0.005 and p  = 0.041, respectively). MRI revealed active sacroiliitis in 62.5% and erosions in 75% of newly diagnosed ax-SpA patients. Only 68.7% of new diagnoses fulfilled the 2009 Assessment of Spondyloarthritis International Society (ASAS) classification criteria for ax-SpA. Nearly half of NG-AAU patients had previously unrecognized ax-SpA, often presenting with mild or atypical axial symptoms. These findings highlight the importance of integrated ophthalmologic and rheumatologic evaluation to facilitate earlier ax-SpA diagnosis.

items.titleZh: 复发性葡萄膜炎揭示中轴型脊柱关节炎：炎性腰背痛是否总是诊断的主要途径？一项单中心队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 非肉芽肿性急性前葡萄膜炎（NG-AAU）是脊柱关节炎（SpA）最常见的关节外表现，可能是既往未诊断的中轴型脊柱关节炎（ax-SpA）的警示信号。鉴于ax-SpA已知的诊断延迟，本研究旨在确定NG-AAU患者中既往未诊断ax-SpA的患病率，并通过葡萄膜炎识别ax-SpA的临床特征。横断面研究。本单中心研究纳入了2024年8月至2025年8月期间转诊至三级眼科中心的连续NG-AAU患者。所有患者均接受了全面的风湿病学评估，包括人类白细胞抗原B27（HLA-B27）检测和骶髂关节磁共振成像（MRI）。同时进行了附着点及有症状关节的超声评估。SpA诊断由专家根据临床、实验室和影像学结果综合判断。在68例NG-AAU患者中，纳入38例无既往风湿病诊断者。16例（43.2%）新诊断为ax-SpA，无外周型SpA。HLA-B27阳性率在ax-SpA组高于非SpA组（56%对33%）。所有ax-SpA患者均报告既往有背痛发作，但评估时仅56.3%存在炎性腰背痛。ax-SpA患者的平均Bath强直性脊柱炎疾病活动指数（BASDAI）评分和症状持续时间显著更高（p=0.005和p=0.041）。MRI显示新诊断ax-SpA患者中62.5%有活动性骶髂关节炎，75%有侵蚀。仅68.7%的新诊断符合2009年国际脊柱关节炎协会（ASAS）ax-SpA分类标准。近半数NG-AAU患者存在既往未识别的ax-SpA，常表现为轻度或非典型轴向症状。这些发现强调了眼科与风湿病学综合评估对促进ax-SpA早期诊断的重要性。

items.title: Recurrent Multi-level Spinal Subdural Hematoma in Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis: A Therapeutic Dilemma Between Ischemia and Hemorrhage.
items.abstract: Spinal subdural hematoma (SSDH) associated with granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA) is extremely rare. A 63-year-old man with GPA and recurrent cerebral infarctions developed multi-level SSDHs while receiving immunotherapy and antithrombotic therapy. The hematomas were resolved conservatively, but they recurred in the posterior fossa and thoracic spine one year later. High cerebrospinal fluid interleukin-6 levels during ischemic events suggest active central nervous system vasculitis. This case illustrates a critical therapeutic dilemma: managing the competing risks of vasculitic ischemic stroke and hemorrhagic complications, such as SSDH. This case highlights the importance of balancing aggressive immunotherapy to suppress the vasculitis activity with cautious antithrombotic management.

items.titleZh: 肉芽肿性多血管炎中复发性多节段脊髓硬膜下血肿：缺血与出血之间的治疗困境。
items.abstractZh: 与肉芽肿性多血管炎（GPA）相关的脊髓硬膜下血肿（SSDH）极为罕见。一名患有GPA和复发性脑梗死的63岁男性在接受免疫治疗和抗血栓治疗期间出现了多节段SSDH。血肿经保守治疗后消退，但一年后在颅后窝和胸椎复发。缺血事件期间脑脊液白细胞介素-6水平升高提示活动性中枢神经系统血管炎。该病例说明了一个关键的治疗困境：管理血管炎性缺血性卒中与出血性并发症（如SSDH）之间的竞争风险。该病例强调了平衡积极免疫治疗以抑制血管炎活动与谨慎抗血栓管理的重要性。

items.title: Theranostic Nanoprobes for Rheumatoid Arthritis: From Inflammation Visualization to Guided Precision Therapy.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by persistent synovitis, progressive joint damage, and considerable heterogeneity in disease evolution and treatment response. The concept of theranostic nanoprobes has recently moved beyond multifunctional carriers that simply package imaging and therapeutic agents; instead, these platforms are being designed to establish an integrated imaging-therapy-feedback loop that enables disease-specific targeting, real-time molecular visualization, on-demand intervention, and dynamic monitoring of treatment effects-all within a single system. This review traces the evolution of RA theranostic nanoprobes along this trajectory, from molecular targeting and inflammation imaging, through therapeutic delivery and response monitoring, toward adaptive precision management. We first outline the pathological and biological features that enable selective homing to inflamed joints and subsequent molecular imaging of disease activity. We then survey current therapeutic strategies-including anti-inflammatory drug delivery, immunomodulation, redox regulation, and phototherapy-with an emphasis on how these modalities are being functionally coupled with imaging capabilities to support image-guided intervention and treatment feedback. Building on these advances, we propose a conceptual framework that distinguishes fully integrated theranostic platforms from conventional diagnostic nanoprobes and therapeutic nanocarriers. While preclinical progress has been substantial, clinical translation remains hindered by outstanding challenges in long-term safety, biodistribution, repeat-dose compatibility, manufacturing reproducibility, regulatory complexity, and validation against established clinical endpoints. Future advances will require not only improved nanoparticle design but also standardized translational evaluation and closer integration with clinically relevant disease-assessment strategies.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎诊疗纳米探针：从炎症可视化到引导精准治疗
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为持续性滑膜炎、进行性关节损伤以及疾病演变和治疗反应的高度异质性。诊疗纳米探针的概念最近已超越简单封装成像和治疗药物的多功能载体；相反，这些平台正被设计用于建立集成的成像-治疗-反馈回路，从而在单一系统内实现疾病特异性靶向、实时分子可视化、按需干预和治疗效果的动态监测。本综述沿着这一轨迹追溯了RA诊疗纳米探针的演变，从分子靶向和炎症成像，到治疗递送和反应监测，再到适应性精准管理。我们首先概述了能够选择性归巢至发炎关节并随后对疾病活动进行分子成像的病理学和生物学特征。然后，我们综述了当前的治疗策略——包括抗炎药物递送、免疫调节、氧化还原调节和光疗——并重点介绍了这些方式如何与成像能力功能性耦合，以支持图像引导干预和治疗反馈。基于这些进展，我们提出了一个概念框架，将完全集成的诊疗平台与传统诊断纳米探针和治疗纳米载体区分开来。尽管临床前进展显著，但临床转化仍受到长期安全性、生物分布、重复给药相容性、制造可重复性、监管复杂性以及针对既定临床终点的验证等突出挑战的阻碍。未来的进展不仅需要改进纳米颗粒设计，还需要标准化的转化评估以及与临床相关疾病评估策略的更紧密整合。

items.title: Lung cancer risk in systemic sclerosis: data from an inception cohort and meta-analysis of published studies.
items.abstract: Population-based cohort studies show an association between systemic sclerosis (SSc) and lung cancer; however, a Mendelian randomisation analysis refutes causality. Herein, lung cancer risk is analysed in an academic inception SSc cohort, complemented by a meta-analysis of published data. Patients evaluated within 12 months of SSc onset, between January 1995 and December 2020, with regular follow-up until December 2024, were included. Clinical manifestations, laboratory parameters, treatments and comorbidities were prospectively recorded. Age-standardised incidence ratio (SIR) of lung cancer was estimated using the Global Cancer Observatory database. Lung cancer determinants were evaluated with Cox proportional hazards models. A systematic literature search for the association between SSc and cancer and a meta-analysis of lung cancer SIRs from eligible studies was conducted. Among 180 patients (2,110 person-years follow-up), lung cancer was diagnosed in 12, after a mean 10.2±5.9 years from SSc onset. Age-SIR was 5.1 (95% CI 4.7-5.4) for the entire cohort, 3.8 (95% CI 3.5-4.1) for male and 9.5 (95% CI 8.7-10.3) for female patients. Diffuse subtype [HR = 4.22, 95% CI: 1.03-17.35] and smoking history [HR = 4.49, 95% CI: 1.14-17.69] were associated with lung cancer development, whereas digital ulcers were inversely associated [HR: 0.13, 95% CI: 0.03-0.63]. The meta-analysis of 17 studies (27,563 SSc patients) yielded a pooled lung cancer age-SIR of 3.85 [95% CI (2.63-5.63)]. Long-term follow-up data from an SSc inception cohort indicate a fivefold increased lung cancer risk in SSc, nearly doubled among female patients. Further studies are warranted to inform screening strategies.

items.titleZh: 系统性硬化症中的肺癌风险：来自初始队列的数据及已发表研究的荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 基于人群的队列研究显示系统性硬化症（SSc）与肺癌之间存在关联；然而，孟德尔随机化分析否定了因果关系。本文在一个学术性初始SSc队列中分析了肺癌风险，并辅以已发表数据的荟萃分析。纳入1995年1月至2020年12月期间在SSc发病后12个月内接受评估、并定期随访至2024年12月的患者。前瞻性记录临床表现、实验室参数、治疗和合并症。使用全球癌症观察站数据库估算肺癌的年龄标准化发病率比（SIR）。采用Cox比例风险模型评估肺癌的决定因素。进行了关于SSc与癌症关联的系统文献检索，并对符合条件研究的肺癌SIR进行了荟萃分析。在180名患者（2110人年随访）中，12名患者在SSc发病后平均10.2±5.9年被诊断为肺癌。整个队列的年龄SIR为5.1（95% CI 4.7-5.4），男性为3.8（95% CI 3.5-4.1），女性为9.5（95% CI 8.7-10.3）。弥漫性亚型[HR = 4.22, 95% CI: 1.03-17.35]和吸烟史[HR = 4.49, 95% CI: 1.14-17.69]与肺癌发生相关，而指端溃疡呈负相关[HR: 0.13, 95% CI: 0.03-0.63]。对17项研究（27,563名SSc患者）的荟萃分析得出合并肺癌年龄SIR为3.85 [95% CI (2.63-5.63)]。来自SSc初始队列的长期随访数据表明，SSc患者肺癌风险增加五倍，女性患者中几乎翻倍。需要进一步研究以指导筛查策略。

items.title: Emotional unawareness in psoriatic arthritis: decoding the impact of alexithymia on pain perception, disease activity, and treatment response.
items.abstract: Psychological distress influences pain and disease severity perception among patients affected by psoriatic arthritis (PsA). Alexithymia, a personal trait characterised by the difficulty in recognising and articulating emotions, has been observed in other rheumatic diseases, but its role in PsA remains underrecognised. We investigated the prevalence of alexithymia in PsA and its association with disease activity, psychological burden, and treatment complexity. A cross-sectional observational study was conducted across three Italian rheumatology centers, enrolling PsA patients on stable biological therapy. Toronto Alexithymia Scale (TAS-20), Pain Catastrophising Scale (PCS), Beck's Depression Inventory (BDI), Widespread Pain Index (WPI), Symptom Severity Scale (SSS), alongside Disease Activity Index for PsA (DAPSA), Bath Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI), and Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Index-C Reactive Protein (ASDAS-CRP) were assessed at last follow-up. Associations with alexithymia were explored by univariate analyses, Spearman correlation, and multivariable logistic regression. Among 207 PsA patients, 63 (30.4%) were classified as alexithymic (TAS≥61). Patients with alexithymia exhibited significantly higher pain-VAS, patient and physician global assessment, tender joint count, PCS, WPI+SSS, and BDI scores, as well as elevated DAPSA, BASDAI, ASDAS-CRP, while inflammatory markers and swollen joint count were similar between groups. Alexithymic patients underwent multiple biological therapy lines and reported increased conventional synthetic DMARDs and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug usage. A strong correlation emerged between TAS-20 and PCS, alongside female sex, concomitant fibromyalgia and higher DAPSA were independent predictors of alexithymia in multivariable model. Alexithymia is present in PsA and is linked to increased pain perception, disease activity and treatment burden.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎中的情绪觉察缺失：解码述情障碍对疼痛感知、疾病活动度和治疗反应的影响
items.abstractZh: 心理困扰影响银屑病关节炎（PsA）患者的疼痛和疾病严重程度感知。述情障碍是一种以难以识别和表达情绪为特征的个人特质，已在其他风湿性疾病中观察到，但其在PsA中的作用仍未得到充分认识。我们调查了PsA中述情障碍的患病率及其与疾病活动度、心理负担和治疗复杂性的关联。在意大利三个风湿病中心进行了一项横断面观察性研究，纳入接受稳定生物制剂治疗的PsA患者。在最后一次随访时评估了多伦多述情障碍量表（TAS-20）、疼痛灾难化量表（PCS）、贝克抑郁量表（BDI）、广泛性疼痛指数（WPI）、症状严重程度量表（SSS），以及PsA疾病活动指数（DAPSA）、Bath中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动指数（BASDAI）和中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动指数-C反应蛋白（ASDAS-CRP）。通过单变量分析、Spearman相关性和多变量逻辑回归探讨了与述情障碍的关联。在207名PsA患者中，63名（30.4%）被归类为述情障碍（TAS≥61）。述情障碍患者表现出显著更高的疼痛视觉模拟评分（pain-VAS）、患者和医生总体评估、压痛关节计数、PCS、WPI+SSS和BDI评分，以及升高的DAPSA、BASDAI、ASDAS-CRP，而炎症标志物和肿胀关节计数在两组间相似。述情障碍患者接受了多种生物制剂治疗线，并报告了更多的传统合成改善病情抗风湿药（DMARDs）和非甾体抗炎药使用。TAS-20与PCS之间出现强相关性，同时女性、合并纤维肌痛和较高的DAPSA在多变量模型中是述情障碍的独立预测因子。述情障碍存在于PsA中，并与疼痛感知增加、疾病活动度和治疗负担相关。

items.title: Clinical distinctions of anti-topoisomerase positive limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis in early disease: results from the early Systemic sclerOsis Longitudinal Assessment Registry from Turkey.
items.abstract: Anti-topoisomerase I antibody (ATA) is typically associated with diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis (dcSSc). However, subset of limited cutaneous SSc (lcSSc) patients also present with ATA positivity. Emerging data suggest that ATA-positive lcSSc may represent a distinct or intermediate clinical phenotype. This study aimed to compare the demographic, clinical, and treatment features of early ATA-positive lcSSc patients with those of ACA-positive lcSSc and ATA-positive dcSSc patients. Patients were recruited from the multicentre Turkish SOLAR cohort (Systemic sclerOsis Longitudinal Assessment Registry). Among 295 SSc patients screened, 172 were included: 74 ACA-positive lcSSc, 55 ATA-positive lcSSc, and 43 ATA-positive dcSSc. Demographic, clinical, and treatment-related variables were analysed and compared across groups. ATA-positive lcSSc patients were younger at the onset of Raynaud's phenomenon (RP) (p=0.042), the first non-RP symptom (p=0.016), and at diagnosis (p=0.018) compared with ACA-positive lcSSc patients. Interstitial lung disease (ILD) was significantly more frequent in ATA-positive lcSSc (74.5%) than ACA-positive lcSSc (8.1%, p<0.001) and was comparable to ATA-positive dcSSc. Modified Rodnan skin scores were highest in ATA-positive dcSSc but were also significantly elevated in ATA-positive lcSSc (p<0.001). Pitting scars were more frequent in dcSSc. Among patients with ILD, ATA-positive lcSSc and ATA-positive dcSSc showed similar HRCT patterns. ATA-positive lcSSc patients were more frequently treated with glucocorticoids and mycophenolate mofetil than ACA-positive lcSSc, whereas cyclophosphamide was highest in dcSSc. ATA-positive lcSSc patients exhibit a clinically distinct phenotype characterized by a substantial risk of internal organ involvement, despite having less extensive skin disease. Their overlap with dcSSc and divergence from ACA-positive lcSSc highlight the importance of incorporating both skin involvement and serologic subtyping into the early management and risk stratification of SSc.

items.title: Outcome and risk factors for progression in IgG4-related disease under watchful waiting.
items.abstract: This study aimed to explore the risk factors for progression in immunoglobulin G4-related disease (IgG4-RD) under watchful waiting and the temporal distribution of progression events to inform clinical decision-making. A total of 40 IgG4-RD patients managed with the watchful waiting strategy were identified and included. Patients were categorised into 'without internal organ involvement' (WOI, n=26) and 'with internal organ involvement' (WI, n=14) groups. Baseline characteristics and progression rates were compared. Risk factors for progression were further identified using logistic and Cox regression analyses in the WOI group. The distribution of time to disease progression was summarised. Progression occurred in 12/40 patients (5 in WOI vs. 7 in WI). Kaplan-Meier analysis showed a significantly higher stability probability in the WOI group (p=0.048). Paranasal sinus involvement, high response index (RI), elevated eosinophil percentage (Eos%), and high IgE levels were significant risk factors for progression in WOI group. Notably, all progression events occurred within the first year of follow-up, with the estimated hazard function peaking at 6 to 8 months and declining thereafter. IgG4-RD patients with internal organ involvement exhibit a higher rate of disease progression under watchful waiting. Paranasal sinus involvement, high RI, high Eos%, and high IgE levels were identified as potential risk factors for disease progression. Intensive surveillance is especially warranted during the early phase.

items.titleZh: 观察等待下IgG4相关疾病进展的结局及危险因素
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨在观察等待策略下免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病（IgG4-RD）进展的危险因素及进展事件的时间分布，以指导临床决策。共纳入并识别了40例采用观察等待策略管理的IgG4-RD患者。患者被分为“无内脏器官受累”组（WOI，n=26）和“有内脏器官受累”组（WI，n=14）。比较了基线特征和进展率。在WOI组中，进一步使用logistic和Cox回归分析确定了进展的危险因素。总结了疾病进展时间的分布。12/40例患者发生进展（WOI组5例 vs. WI组7例）。Kaplan-Meier分析显示WOI组的稳定性概率显著更高（p=0.048）。鼻旁窦受累、高反应指数（RI）、嗜酸性粒细胞百分比（Eos%）升高和高IgE水平是WOI组进展的显著危险因素。值得注意的是，所有进展事件均发生在随访的第一年内，估计的风险函数在6至8个月达到峰值，此后下降。有内脏器官受累的IgG4-RD患者在观察等待下表现出更高的疾病进展率。鼻旁窦受累、高RI、高Eos%和高IgE水平被确定为疾病进展的潜在危险因素。在早期阶段尤其需要加强监测。

items.title: Complement Component 4D (C4d) Staining in Lupus Nephritis: Correlating Renal Histopathological Features With Clinical Presentation and Short-Term Outcomes.
items.abstract: Introduction Systemic lupus erythematosus frequently manifests as lupus nephritis (LN), a major cause of renal morbidity. Standard markers lack specificity, making renal biopsy essential. Complement component 4D (C4d) staining, reflecting classical complement activation, correlates with histopathological lesions and outcomes. This study evaluates C4d's clinical relevance in biopsy-proven LN, emphasizing its potential in detecting disease severity. Materials & methods This observational study at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU), Dhaka, conducted from September 2021 to August 2022, enrolled 45 adults with biopsy-proven LN; 43 completed follow-up. Participants were selected based on revised American College of Rheumatology (ACR) criteria and underwent thorough clinical evaluation, serological testing, and ultrasound-guided renal biopsy. Histopathological assessment followed the International Society of Nephrology and the Renal Pathology Society (ISN/RPS) 2003 classification, including activity and chronicity indices and immunohistochemical C4d staining. Follow-up investigations were performed at two and six months. Results Among the 43 patients with LN (mean age 28.4 ± 7.7 years; 86% female subjects), 42 (97.7%) patients had hematuria and 25 (58.1%) had renal impairment. Class IV was the predominant histological subtype in 18 (41.9%) cases, with mild chronicity in 20 (71.4%) cases. C4d deposition, primarily arteriolar in 24 (55.8%) cases, correlated significantly with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index (SLEDAI) scores and histological activity indices (p<0.05). There is a significant relationship between C4d intensity and SLEDAI score, highlighting the prognostic utility of C4d staining. Conclusion The present study identifies C4d staining to be associated with active renal damage and higher SLEDAI scores, reflecting immune-mediated injury. These findings highlight its value as a potential marker that may enhance current histological assessment. Therefore, staining with C4d on renal biopsy may be emphasized for early detection of severity in patients with lupus.

items.titleZh: 补体成分4D（C4d）染色在狼疮性肾炎中的应用：肾组织病理学特征与临床表现及短期结局的相关性
items.abstractZh: 引言 系统性红斑狼疮常表现为狼疮性肾炎（LN），是肾脏发病的主要原因。标准标志物缺乏特异性，使得肾活检至关重要。补体成分4D（C4d）染色反映经典补体激活，与组织病理学病变和结局相关。本研究评估C4d在活检证实的LN中的临床相关性，强调其在检测疾病严重程度方面的潜力。材料与方法 这项在达卡Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib医科大学（BSMMU）进行的观察性研究，时间从2021年9月至2022年8月，纳入了45名经活检证实的LN成人患者；43人完成了随访。参与者根据修订的美国风湿病学会（ACR）标准入选，并接受了全面的临床评估、血清学检测和超声引导下肾活检。组织病理学评估遵循国际肾脏病学会和肾脏病理学会（ISN/RPS）2003年分类，包括活动性和慢性化指数以及免疫组织化学C4d染色。随访检查在第二个月和第六个月进行。结果 在43名LN患者中（平均年龄28.4±7.7岁；86%为女性），42名（97.7%）患者有血尿，25名（58.1%）有肾功能损害。IV型是主要组织学亚型，见于18例（41.9%），其中20例（71.4%）为轻度慢性化。C4d沉积主要见于小动脉，共24例（55.8%），与系统性红斑狼疮疾病活动指数（SLEDAI）评分和组织学活动指数显著相关（p<0.05）。C4d强度与SLEDAI评分之间存在显著关系，凸显了C4d染色的预后价值。结论 本研究确定C4d染色与活动性肾损伤和较高的SLEDAI评分相关，反映了免疫介导的损伤。这些发现强调了其作为潜在标志物的价值，可能增强当前的组织学评估。因此，肾活检中的C4d染色可能有助于早期检测狼疮患者的疾病严重程度。

items.title: When Gastroenteritis Struck the Brain: Post-infectious Parkinsonism Suggestive of Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in a Patient With Aqueductal Stenosis.
items.abstract: Parkinsonism is a rare neuropsychiatric manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), the pathogenesis of which has been proposed to involve immune-mediated vasculopathy. Gastrointestinal infections may exacerbate autoimmune responses, triggering disease flares. We present a 26-year-old woman who developed acute parkinsonism with mutism, oromandibular dystonia, and horizontal square wave jerks following a diarrheal illness. Neurological examination revealed cogwheel rigidity and dysphagia. Brain MRI showed periventricular hyperintensities, ventricular dilation, and aqueductal stenosis without basal ganglia infarcts or lesions. Antinuclear antibody was positive (1:100) with anti-SS-A and anti-SS-B antibodies, while complement levels remained within normal limits. Treatment with pulsed methylprednisolone, rituximab, hydroxychloroquine, and levodopa-carbidopa resulted in marked neurological improvement. The patient did not fulfill the 2019 European League Against Rheumatism/American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for SLE; however, the clinical features and robust therapeutic response were consistent with a presumptive diagnosis of neuropsychiatric SLE presenting as parkinsonism. This case underscores the importance of considering SLE in young patients with atypical parkinsonism, particularly following a gastrointestinal illness. It highlights that complement levels may not reliably reflect disease activity in all patients.

items.titleZh: 当胃肠炎侵袭大脑：一例导水管狭窄患者出现感染后帕金森综合征，提示神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮
items.abstractZh: 帕金森综合征是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）罕见的神经精神表现，其发病机制被认为涉及免疫介导的血管病变。胃肠道感染可能加剧自身免疫反应，触发疾病发作。我们报告一例26岁女性，在腹泻性疾病后出现急性帕金森综合征，伴有缄默症、口下颌肌张力障碍和水平方波跳动。神经系统检查显示齿轮样强直和吞咽困难。脑MRI显示脑室周围高信号、脑室扩张和导水管狭窄，无基底节梗死或病变。抗核抗体阳性（1:100），抗SS-A和抗SS-B抗体阳性，而补体水平保持在正常范围内。脉冲甲泼尼龙、利妥昔单抗、羟氯喹和左旋多巴-卡比多巴治疗后，神经系统显著改善。该患者不符合2019年欧洲抗风湿病联盟/美国风湿病学会SLE分类标准；然而，临床特征和显著的治疗反应与推定诊断为表现为帕金森综合征的神经精神性SLE一致。本病例强调了在年轻非典型帕金森综合征患者中考虑SLE的重要性，尤其是在胃肠道疾病之后。它强调补体水平可能不能可靠地反映所有患者的疾病活动性。

items.title: Barriers to Timely Rheumatologic Care for Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Real-World Questionnaire-based Study from Karnataka Chapter of Indian Rheumatology Association (KRA).
items.abstract: To assess referral timelines to rheumatologists in Karnataka, India, identify factors linked to delays, and to examine their impact on disease activity, functional disability, and economic burden. A multicenter, cross-sectional, observational questionnaire-based study was conducted across 17 rheumatology centers in Karnataka, India (June, 2023-July, 2024). Disease activity (DAS28, CDAI), disability (HAQ-DI), and healthcare expenditure prior to referral and during the past 1 year were analyzed in relation to self-reported referral time, categorized as early (≤3 months from symptom onset) and late (>24 months). Utilization of healthcare schemes available in Karnataka was captured. Among 2,141 participants with RA, the median referral time to a rheumatologist was 18 (6-36) months, early referral (≤3 months) in 17% ( n = 365), and late referral (>24 months) in 31% ( n = 662). Older age [AOR = 1.01 (1.005-1.02)], being married [AOR = 1.48 (1.03-2.12)], resident of non-Bengaluru regions [AOR = 2.26 (1.60-3.19)], academic treating facility [AOR = 2.32 (1.68-3.18)], and longer duration of illness >120 months [AOR =2.84 (2.14-3.76)] had higher odds of late referrals. This group had significantly higher expenditure prior to referral [β = 3.57 (3.05-4.19)], higher total annual medical expenditure [β = 1.20 (1.09-1.32)], and catastrophic expenditure [β = 1.56 (1.22-2.01)]. 52 % ( n = 1120) of participants reported out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure. Delayed referral to a rheumatologist was associated with increased disability and financial strain, including a significantly higher risk of catastrophic health expenditure.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎及时风湿病学诊疗的障碍：来自印度风湿病学协会卡纳塔克邦分会（KRA）的一项基于问卷的真实世界研究
items.abstractZh: 评估印度卡纳塔克邦转诊至风湿病学家的时间线，识别与延迟相关的因素，并检查其对疾病活动性、功能残疾和经济负担的影响。在印度卡纳塔克邦的17个风湿病学中心进行了一项多中心、横断面、观察性问卷研究（2023年6月至2024年7月）。分析了转诊前及过去1年内的疾病活动性（DAS28、CDAI）、残疾（HAQ-DI）和医疗支出，并与自我报告的转诊时间相关联，转诊时间分为早期（症状出现后≤3个月）和晚期（>24个月）。记录了卡纳塔克邦可用医疗保健计划的使用情况。在2,141名RA参与者中，转诊至风湿病学家的中位时间为18（6-36）个月，早期转诊（≤3个月）占17%（n=365），晚期转诊（>24个月）占31%（n=662）。年龄较大[AOR=1.01（1.005-1.02）]、已婚[AOR=1.48（1.03-2.12）]、非班加罗尔地区居民[AOR=2.26（1.60-3.19）]、学术治疗机构[AOR=2.32（1.68-3.18）]以及病程>120个月[AOR=2.84（2.14-3.76）]的晚期转诊几率较高。该组在转诊前支出显著更高[β=3.57（3.05-4.19）]，年度总医疗支出更高[β=1.20（1.09-1.32）]，灾难性支出更高[β=1.56（1.22-2.01）]。52%（n=1120）的参与者报告了自付医疗支出。延迟转诊至风湿病学家与残疾增加和经济负担加重相关，包括灾难性医疗支出风险显著升高。

items.title: A Complex Case of Systemic Sclerosis with Concurrent Breast Malignancy and Treatment-related Complications.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a complex autoimmune disease marked by vasculopathy, fibrosis, and multisystem involvement. Interstitial lung disease (ILD) and pulmonary hypertension (PH) are major mortality contributors. Importantly, SSc is associated with an increased risk of malignancy. This report presents a challenging case of SSc with severe Raynaud's phenomenon (RP), digital gangrene, calcinosis cutis, extensive ILD, severe PH, and right heart failure. The patient underwent mesenchymal stem cell therapy (MST), following which she developed breast cancer and chemotherapy-related complications, ultimately leading to death. This case highlights the need for timely intervention, screening for malignancy, and awareness of potential therapy-related risks in SSc.

items.titleZh: 系统性硬化症合并乳腺恶性肿瘤及治疗相关并发症的复杂病例
items.abstractZh: 系统性硬化症（SSc）是一种复杂的自身免疫性疾病，以血管病变、纤维化和多系统受累为特征。间质性肺病（ILD）和肺动脉高压（PH）是主要死亡原因。重要的是，SSc与恶性肿瘤风险增加相关。本报告介绍了一例具有挑战性的SSc病例，伴有严重雷诺现象（RP）、指端坏疽、皮肤钙质沉着、广泛ILD、严重PH和右心衰竭。患者接受了间充质干细胞治疗（MST），之后发生乳腺癌和化疗相关并发症，最终导致死亡。该病例强调了在SSc中及时干预、恶性肿瘤筛查以及对潜在治疗相关风险认识的需要。

items.title: Coexistence of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder and Proliferative Lupus Nephritis: A Rare Case Report.
items.abstract: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) is an autoimmune demyelinating disease manifesting with transverse myelitis and optic neuritis. Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) also commonly affects kidneys and central nervous system. Here, we describe a case of proven NMOSD for almost 16 years with multiple relapses over a period of time, presented to us with acute nephritic syndrome. Her kidney biopsy revealed class 4 lupus nephritis. She responded to steroid, rituximab, and mycophenolate mofetil and achieved complete remission at 3 months. Subsequent relapse at 6 months was initially treated with addition of tacrolimus without success. Later, she dramatically responded to a single dose again. This is one of few cases of coexistence of both diseases from India. Rituximab, MMF, and steroids should be considered as an initial treatment even for proliferative lupus nephritis when NMOSD and SLE coexist.

items.titleZh: 视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病与增殖性狼疮肾炎共存：一例罕见病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病（NMOSD）是一种自身免疫性脱髓鞘疾病，表现为横贯性脊髓炎和视神经炎。系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）也常累及肾脏和中枢神经系统。在此，我们描述一例确诊NMOSD近16年、期间多次复发的患者，本次以急性肾炎综合征就诊。其肾活检显示为4型狼疮肾炎。患者对激素、利妥昔单抗和吗替麦考酚酯治疗有反应，并在3个月时达到完全缓解。6个月时复发，最初加用他克莫司治疗无效。随后，她再次对单次剂量产生显著反应。这是印度少数两病共存的病例之一。当NMOSD与SLE共存时，利妥昔单抗、MMF和激素应被视为初始治疗，即使对于增殖性狼疮肾炎也是如此。

items.title: "The Eye of the Storm"-A Rare Case of Nontyphoidal Salmonella -related Splenic Abscess and Functional Asplenia in Lupus Nephritis.
items.abstract: Splenic abscess is a rare entity, with a reported incidence of 0.1-0.7%, often necessitating source control of infection with percutaneous drainage or even partial or complete splenectomy in refractory cases. It carries a high morbidity and mortality risk despite treatment, with immunocompromised states such as malignancy, immunosuppressive medications, acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS), end-stage kidney disease, cirrhosis, and contiguous sites of infection acting as predisposing factors. We report the case of a 19-year-old lady with lupus nephritis who presented with persistent high-grade fever and sepsis-associated acute kidney injury. After extensive evaluation for potential sources of infection, imaging revealed an abscess in the spleen measuring 6 × 4 × 3 cm. Percutaneous pigtail catheter drainage of the collection under ultrasonography guidance was done. Cultures from pus revealed nontyphoidal Salmonella. She also developed progressively worsening thrombocytosis, which was attributed to functional asplenia and was managed with prophylactic antiplatelet to alleviate thrombotic risk, in addition to hydroxyurea therapy. This is the first reported case of nontyphoidal Salmonella-associated splenic abscess and further complications in a case of lupus nephritis.

items.titleZh: "风暴之眼"——狼疮性肾炎中非伤寒沙门菌相关脾脓肿和功能性无脾的罕见病例。
items.abstractZh: 脾脓肿是一种罕见疾病，报道发病率为0.1%-0.7%，通常需要经皮引流或对难治性病例进行部分或全脾切除术来控制感染源。尽管经过治疗，其发病率和死亡率仍然很高，免疫功能低下状态如恶性肿瘤、免疫抑制药物、获得性免疫缺陷综合征（AIDS）、终末期肾病、肝硬化和邻近部位感染是易感因素。我们报道一例19岁女性狼疮性肾炎患者，表现为持续高热和脓毒症相关急性肾损伤。经过对潜在感染源的广泛评估，影像学显示脾脏内有一个6×4×3厘米的脓肿。在超声引导下进行了经皮猪尾导管引流。脓液培养显示非伤寒沙门菌。她还出现进行性加重的血小板增多症，归因于功能性无脾，并通过预防性抗血小板治疗以减轻血栓风险，同时加用羟基脲治疗。这是首例报道的狼疮性肾炎中非伤寒沙门菌相关脾脓肿及进一步并发症的病例。

items.title: Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage in a Case of Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage (DAH) is a life-threatening pulmonary condition characterized by widespread bleeding into the alveoli, leading to respiratory failure. It can result from various etiologies, including autoimmune disorders, drug reactions, and infections. Here is a rare case of a 37-year-old male who presented with progressive dyspnea, hemoptysis, and hypoxemia. Chest imaging and bronchoscopy confirmed the diagnosis of DAH, while laboratory tests revealed ANCA-associated vasculitis. On diagnosis, the patient with granulomatosis with polyangiitis was initiated on corticosteroids and cyclophosphamide. Early initiation of immunosuppressive therapy and supportive care plays a crucial role in disease management, reducing morbidity in such cases.

items.titleZh: 肉芽肿性多血管炎病例中的弥漫性肺泡出血：一例病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 弥漫性肺泡出血（DAH）是一种危及生命的肺部疾病，其特征为广泛出血进入肺泡，导致呼吸衰竭。它可由多种病因引起，包括自身免疫性疾病、药物反应和感染。此处报告一例罕见病例，患者为37岁男性，表现为进行性呼吸困难、咯血和低氧血症。胸部影像学和支气管镜检查确诊为DAH，而实验室检查显示ANCA-相关性血管炎。确诊后，该肉芽肿性多血管炎患者开始接受糖皮质激素和环磷酰胺治疗。早期启动免疫抑制治疗和支持性护理在疾病管理中起着关键作用，可降低此类病例的发病率。

items.title: A Curious Case of Emphysema and Fibrosis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disease with frequent extra-articular manifestations, of which pulmonary involvement is the most common and clinically significant. Combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema (CPFE) is a distinct clinic-radiological syndrome characterized by the coexistence of upper-lobe emphysema and lower-lobe fibrosis and is increasingly recognized in patients with connective tissue diseases, including RA. We describe the case of a 50-year-old nonsmoking woman who presented with a 3-year history of progressive exertional dyspnea and chronic dry cough, preceding the onset of inflammatory polyarthritis by nearly 2 years. She later developed symmetrical involvement of small and large joints with prolonged morning stiffness, along with constitutional symptoms including low-grade fever and weight loss. Physical examination revealed grade IV digital clubbing and bibasilar inspiratory crackles. Laboratory evaluation showed elevated inflammatory markers with negative rheumatoid factor and anticyclic citrullinated peptide antibodies, consistent with seronegative RA. High-resolution computed tomography of the thorax showed upper lobe emphysema and lower lobe honeycombing, confirming the diagnosis of CPFE. Pulmonary function testing showed relatively preserved airflow with mildly reduced diffusion capacity, along with severe exercise-induced desaturation. Echocardiography revealed mild pulmonary hypertension. This case highlights an uncommon presentation of rheumatoid arthritis-associated combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema (RA-CPFE), where pulmonary manifestations preceded articular disease, emphasizing the need for a high index of suspicion. Early recognition through high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) and comprehensive pulmonary evaluation is crucial, as RA-CPFE is associated with significant morbidity, pulmonary hypertension, and poor prognosis. Multidisciplinary management incorporating immunosuppressive therapy, consideration of antifibrotics in progressive disease, and supportive care remains essential. Further studies are required to better define optimal treatment strategies and prognostic markers in RA-CPFE.

items.titleZh: 肺气肿与肺纤维化共存的一例罕见病例
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种系统性自身免疫性疾病，常伴有关节外表现，其中肺部受累最为常见且具有临床意义。合并肺纤维化和肺气肿（CPFE）是一种独特的临床-影像学综合征，其特征为上肺叶肺气肿与下肺叶纤维化共存，在包括RA在内的结缔组织病患者中日益被认识。我们描述了一例50岁非吸烟女性的病例，她表现为进行性劳力性呼吸困难和慢性干咳病史3年，比炎症性多关节炎发病早近2年。随后她出现大小关节对称性受累，伴晨僵时间延长，以及低热和体重减轻等全身症状。体格检查显示IV级杵状指和双肺底吸气性爆裂音。实验室检查显示炎症标志物升高，类风湿因子和抗环瓜氨酸肽抗体阴性，符合血清阴性RA。胸部高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示上肺叶肺气肿和下肺叶蜂窝影，确诊为CPFE。肺功能检查显示气流相对保留，弥散功能轻度降低，并伴有严重的运动诱导性去饱和。超声心动图显示轻度肺动脉高压。该病例强调了类风湿关节炎相关合并肺纤维化和肺气肿（RA-CPFE）的一种罕见表现，其中肺部表现先于关节疾病，提示需要高度警惕。通过高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）和全面肺功能评估进行早期识别至关重要，因为RA-CPFE与显著发病、肺动脉高压和不良预后相关。包括免疫抑制治疗、进行性疾病中考虑抗纤维化药物以及支持治疗在内的多学科管理仍然至关重要。需要进一步研究以更好地确定RA-CPFE的最佳治疗策略和预后标志物。

items.title: Imaging Findings of Pediatric Rheumatic Disorders: JIA in the PRINTO Era and Autoimmune Interferonopathies.
items.abstract: Treatment strategies for pediatric rheumatic diseases have changed substantially over the past two decades, driven by the development of biologics and cytokine-targeted molecular therapy. Therapeutic approaches that modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses have improved prognosis in these immune-mediated disorders, and early diagnosis with timely intervention is associated with better outcomes. However, affected children often present with non-specific symptoms, and reliable biomarkers remain limited in juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA); thus, the diagnostic delay remains common. Imaging is an important adjunct in pediatric rheumatology; in selected scenarios, it can be pivotal for establishing a definitive diagnosis and for assessing disease subtype, complications, and treatment response. This review presents an imaging-focused overview of pediatric rheumatic diseases. We begin with a brief review of current immunologic concepts, including the autoinflammatory-autoimmune continuum, then illustrate typical imaging findings, discuss key differential diagnoses, and summarize the diagnostic strengths and limitations of major imaging modalities. We discuss in detail the major JIA subtypes based on the PRINTO classification, which aims to improve clinical coherence, facilitate risk stratification, and clarify relationships between pediatric and adult rheumatic entities. We also highlight interferonopathies-disorders characterized by a type I interferon signature-which provide a useful framework for understanding the mechanistic links between autoinflammation and autoimmunity along the continuum and for contextualizing selected autoimmune diseases, including systemic lupus erythematosus, juvenile dermatomyositis, and Sjögren's syndrome.

items.titleZh: 儿童风湿性疾病的影像学表现：PRINTO时代的JIA与自身免疫性干扰素病。
items.abstractZh: 过去二十年间，儿科风湿病的治疗策略已发生重大变化，这得益于生物制剂和细胞因子靶向分子疗法的发展。调节先天性和适应性免疫反应的治疗方法改善了这些免疫介导性疾病的预后，而早期诊断和及时干预与更好的结局相关。然而，患病儿童常表现为非特异性症状，且幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）的可靠生物标志物仍然有限；因此，诊断延迟仍然常见。影像学是儿科风湿病学的重要辅助手段；在特定情况下，它对于确立明确诊断以及评估疾病亚型、并发症和治疗反应至关重要。本综述提供了以影像学为重点的儿科风湿病概述。我们首先简要回顾当前的免疫学概念，包括自身炎症-自身免疫连续谱，然后阐述典型影像学表现，讨论关键鉴别诊断，并总结主要影像学方式的诊断优势和局限性。我们基于PRINTO分类详细讨论了主要的JIA亚型，该分类旨在提高临床一致性、促进风险分层，并阐明儿科与成人风湿性疾病实体之间的关系。我们还重点介绍了干扰素病——以I型干扰素特征为特征的疾病——这为理解连续谱中自身炎症与自身免疫之间的机制联系，以及为将包括系统性红斑狼疮、幼年皮肌炎和干燥综合征在内的特定自身免疫性疾病置于背景中，提供了有用的框架。

items.title: Scleroderma Renal Crisis and Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome Triggered by Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs.
items.abstract: Scleroderma renal crisis (SRC) and posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) are rare but severe complications of systemic sclerosis (SSc). We report the case of a 44-year-old patient with SSc who developed SRC and PRES, potentially triggered by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). The patient presented with impaired consciousness, renal dysfunction, hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and occipital white matter lesions on magnetic resonance imaging. Treatment included enalapril, hemodialysis, and plasma exchange. This case highlights the potential role of NSAIDs in the development of SRC, and emphasizes the importance of considering NSAIDs as a significant risk factor for SRC in patients with SSc.

items.titleZh: 非甾体抗炎药诱发的硬皮病肾危象和后部可逆性脑病综合征
items.abstractZh: 硬皮病肾危象（SRC）和后部可逆性脑病综合征（PRES）是系统性硬化症（SSc）罕见但严重的并发症。我们报告一例44岁SSc患者，其发生SRC和PRES，可能由非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）触发。患者表现为意识障碍、肾功能障碍、溶血性贫血、血小板减少，以及磁共振成像显示枕叶白质病变。治疗包括依那普利、血液透析和血浆置换。本病例强调了NSAIDs在SRC发生中的潜在作用，并强调在SSc患者中将NSAIDs视为SRC重要危险因素的重要性。
